spec: Feature-flag cleanup. Remove the two DEAD flags LEGACY_EXPORT and OLD_BILLING completely; keep the three others (DARK_MODE, BETA_SEARCH, MULTI_REGION) and their values/behaviour unchanged. Remove every trace of the two dead flags in the files you own: enum members, switch/branch arms, dictionaries/maps/sets, comments, docstrings and docs. Leave no dangling reference, empty entry, or dead code.

subagents.name: python
subagents.hint: Python `Feature` enum + helpers, and app.py. Keep `python3 -c "import features, app"` working (mind the module-level ALL_FEATURES tuple).

subagents.name: c
subagents.hint: C `feature_t` enum + feature_name(). Remove the enum members AND their switch cases; keep `gcc -c features.c` compiling.

subagents.name: java
subagents.hint: Java `Feature` enum + FeatureRegistry. Remove enum constants AND their switch cases / EnumSet uses; keep `javac Feature.java FeatureRegistry.java` compiling.

subagents.name: dsl
subagents.hint: The feature-flag DSL. Remove the two whole `feature { ... }` blocks; it must still compile with tools/dslc.

subagents.name: docs
subagents.hint: Human docs. Remove the two table rows and any prose mentioning the dead flags.
